details: Danteshwari Devi Temple, Dantewada listing specifies 18°53′48″N, 81°20′42″E and the east-facing pyramidal sanctuary, pillared audience hall and pillared dancing hall. Its Barsoor listing has separate coordinates.
Indian Archaeology 1987–88, pages 165–166. Survey documents axial rooms, terracotta entry roof, Garuda-stambha, divided masonry elevations and the nine pidhas with their finial.
The temple operator distinguishes the stone sanctuary, antarala and Mukhmandap from the timber-and-terracotta hall structures.
